$comment: Owner-approved, time-limited dependency-audit exceptions. Read by web/scripts/audit-gate.mjs; rules in web/scripts/lib/audit-policy.mjs; record in docs/web/dependency-audit-exceptions.md. An entry that expires, goes obsolete or stops matching the verified dependency graph FAILS the Dependency audit job. Never add an entry without the owner's recorded decision.

exceptions.rationale: minimatch <11.0.1 can be driven into a denial of service by a crafted glob (CWE-405). It is reachable only through the ESLint toolchain, a devDependency that is never bundled: the production audit reports 0 vulnerabilities, and the glob patterns are repository-authored configuration and file paths. No compatible fix exists: the latest release of every consumer pins minimatch ^3.1.x or ^10.x, no published version of any of them accepts minimatch >= 11, and minimatch 11 no longer exports the callable default that eslint-plugin-react, eslint-plugin-import and eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y call (a global override crashes those rules at lint time, verified).
exceptions.removalCriteria: Remove this entry as soon as the audit no longer reports GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 for web/ (the gate fails an obsolete entry on its own). That needs releases of @eslint/config-array, @eslint/eslintrc, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree and eslint-plugin-react / -import / -jsx-a11y (or eslint-config-next dropping them) that accept minimatch >= 11.0.1. Re-check upstream before 2026-12-15; the exception is not renewed automatically and the gate fails closed from 2026-12-16 00:00 UTC.
